summary.intent: Get a release of the project ready to ship by clearing release blockers, making sure the release PR (#558) shows all required upgrade steps, and ordering merges so breaking changes land in a single release.
summary.outcome: All release blockers had merged (#599 last). Opened PR #606 to fix the release workflow's Action steps in the changeset as one paragraph, and recommended a merge order: #606, then #603 (breaking CLI cleanup) with #604/#605, then release PR #558. #606 is in CI as a draft and #603-#605 are in the merge queue.

repo: The release PR body is generated from changesets, so the **Action:** steps in a changeset must be one self-contained paragraph to show every step on the release PR.
#603 (CLI cleanup) carries two Breaking items: the merged dry-run error codes and removal of `--refresh-lockfiles`. Merge it before the release so all breaking changes ship in one upgrade.
Commits in this repo are signed.
The release PR #558 has a 'Read before merging' section to check before merging, and it refreshes after other PRs land.
workflow: Background watcher commands that poll sessions and PRs for changes were used to track merge and CI state without blocking.
Worktrees (EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree) were used to branch off main for a small fix without disturbing the current checkout.
PRs are opened as drafts and marked ready once CI is green.

friction: #606 was opened as a draft, so it needs to be manually marked ready after CI passes before it can merge.
The Action steps in the changeset had been split across multiple paragraphs, so the release PR would not have shown every step until fixed.
open_items: Mark #606 ready for review once CI is green.
Merge #603 (plus optionally #604 and #605) before cutting the release.
Merge release PR #558 after it refreshes, check 'Read before merging', and watch the release run.
